leaveDesc: Check remaining leave quota and submit online leave requests to your manager.
approvalDesc: Review leave requests from subordinates, check reasons, and approve or reject them.
adminDesc: Add/remove employees, set initial passwords, and view company employee IDs.
heroDesc: Elevate your organization with an employee database, online leave requests, and manager approval dashboards. All essential HR functions combined into one secure platform.
feat1Desc: Register new staff, assign departments, and control role-based access permissions strictly.
feat2Desc: Employees can submit leave requests and track their remaining quota in real-time.
feat3Desc: Managers review, approve, or reject leave requests securely through their personal dashboard.
